preamble: Coronalization of the bilabial stop [p] to [t]. In attested cases this is regressive assimilation in a stop cluster, *pt > tt. It happened in Middle Indo-Aryan (Sanskrit sapta > Prakrit satta) and in Italian (Latin septem > sette).

examples.note: Middle Indo-Aryan regressive assimilation of stop clusters; the geminate later simplified with compensatory lengthening
Latin -pt- assimilated to geminate -tt- in Italian.

sources: Masica, C. P. (1991). The Indo-Aryan Languages. Cambridge University Press.
